"""Hand-checked semantic edge cases."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys

MAIN = "/workspace/submission/main.py"


def run(req):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", MAIN],
                       input=(json.dumps(req) + "\n").encode(), capture_output=True, timeout=60)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()
    return json.loads(p.stdout.decode())


def dfa_of(req):
    out = run(req)
    assert out.get("ok"), out
    return out["dfa"]


# empty-path atoms
for op, expect_all in (("match", False), ("startswith", True), ("endswith", True), ("contains", True)):
    d = dfa_of({"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": op, "path": []}}],
                "queries": [[], ["a"]]})
    if expect_all:
        assert d["accept"] == [True] and d["next"] == [[0]], (op, d)
    else:
        # only the empty word is accepted
        assert d["accept"] == [True, False], (op, d)
        assert d["next"][0] == [1] and d["next"][1] == [1], (op, d)
    print("empty path %-10s ok" % op)

# control characters and punctuation in service tokens
tokens = ["a b", 'q"q', "x\ty", "\u0001", "\u00e9", "\\"]
d = dfa_of({"services": tokens, "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": ["x\ty", "\u0001"]}}],
            "queries": [["x\ty", "\u0001"], ["a b"]]})
assert d["accept"] == [False, False, True], d
print("odd tokens ok")

# contradictory rules: drop wins
d = dfa_of({"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "true"}},
                                          {"action": "drop", "when": {"op": "true"}}],
            "queries": [[], ["a"]]})
assert d["accept"] == [False], d
print("drop overrides allow ok")

# drop narrower than allow
d = dfa_of({"services": ["a", "b"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "startswith", "path": ["a"]}},
                                            {"action": "drop", "when": {"op": "match", "path": ["a", "b"]}}],
            "queries": [["a"], ["a", "b"], ["a", "a"]]})
assert d["accept"] == [False, True, False], d
print("narrow drop ok")

# and/or arity edge cases
d = dfa_of({"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "and", "args": []}}], "queries": []})
assert d["accept"] == [True], d
d = dfa_of({"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "or", "args": []}}], "queries": []})
assert d["accept"] == [False], d
print("and/or arity ok")

# no allow rules -> empty language
d = dfa_of({"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "drop", "when": {"op": "true"}}], "queries": []})
assert d["accept"] == [False] and d["next"] == [[0]] and d["distance"] == [None], d
print("no allow rules ok")

# negation over the empty path (complement includes epsilon)
d = dfa_of({"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "not", "arg": {"op": "match", "path": []}}}],
            "queries": [[], ["a"]]})
assert d["accept"] == [False], d
print("negation includes epsilon ok")

# repeated tokens in a path
d = dfa_of({"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": ["a", "a", "a"]}}],
            "queries": [["a", "a"], ["a", "a", "a"], ["a", "a", "a", "a"]]})
assert d["accept"][2] is True and d["accept"][3] is False, d
print("repeated tokens ok")

# overlapping suffixes
d = dfa_of({"services": ["a", "b"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "endswith", "path": ["a", "b", "a"]}}],
            "queries": [["a", "b", "a"], ["b", "a"], ["a"]]})
assert d["accept"][3] is True, d
print("overlapping suffixes ok")
print("ALL EDGE CASES PASS")
PYEOF
